engine_requirements: New adapter html_cards (plain GET, no cookies, edge UA). Fetch https://www.bsf.org.il/. Parse each <li class="funding-block..."> block: title from h4.funding-block__title, url from a.funding-block__fill-link href, deadline text from div.funding-block__date-date (format "Month D, YYYY"). Emit one opportunity per card: external_id=url, title, url, deadline=parsed date, status=open if deadline >= today else closed. Store deadline_text and deadline_source=funder_homepage_card. If zero cards parse, raise an error and keep the last good rows (never store empty). Alert when the page cannot be fetched or the program card disappears. Cross-check: the submission subpage text must not contradict a dated card; when it says To be announced, store a verification_note, not a second deadline. Other BSF programs on the same homepage (BSF Research Grants Dec 2 2026, Rahamimoff Dec 16 2026) also parse with this adapter but are out of scope for this row.

check.note: html adapter stores no rows; count 0 is expected for monitor mode. Proof of extraction is the prototype below, not adapter_check.

prototype: python -I proto_bsf_cards.py (scratchpad). Fetches https://www.bsf.org.il/ with browser UA and regex-parses li.funding-block cards.

row_fix.reason: Row points at atomgrants aggregator; the funder own page gives the dated card. Keep the aggregator only as a title cross-check.
